operators.name: pad2d_constant

returns.shape: same as reference padded shape, with height+2*pad, width+2*pad

semantics: Performs constant padding on a 4D tensor input of shape [N,C,H,W] with pad value 'pad' on height and width dimensions only.
Pads symmetrically: adds 'pad' rows/columns on each side (top, bottom, left, right) with constant 'value'.
Returns a new tensor of shape [N,C,H+2*pad,W+2*pad] with dtype float32 and on the same device as input (CUDA).
Input must be contiguous; output is contiguous.

operators.name: sum_all
semantics: Computes the sum of all elements of the input tensor.
Returns a 0-dimensional tensor containing the sum as a float32 value.
Reduction performs in the same dtype (float32) and returns a CUDA scalar tensor.
Applies ConstantPad2d with padding=(2,2,2,2), value=0 to input x of shape [16,3,2048,2048].
Output shape [16,3,2052,2052], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
Computes the sum of all elements of the padded tensor.
Output is a 0-dimensional scalar tensor, dtype float32, device cuda:0.
